projectDescription: A cyber-occult portfolio template built with React, featuring a dark neon aesthetic, animated particle fields, SVG sigils, and thematic components for showcasing projects, skills, writing, and case studies.
keyFeatures: Animated particle field background using Canvas API with neon purple, cyan, and magenta particles
SVG sigil system with 18+ hand-crafted geometric glyphs used for navigation and decoration
Cyber-occult design language with neon glow effects (purple, magenta, cyan, lime) and dark base colors
React + React Router v6 SPA with Framer Motion page transitions and scroll-triggered animations
Responsive layout with Tailwind CSS utility classes and custom CSS variables
SummoningCircle interactive project selector with ProjectPanel detail view
Timeline-based about/background section with animated entries
TraitSigilGrid for personality traits with hover animations
RuneTile skill display grid with mastery levels and categorical grouping
TomeCard writing log with channel categorization
RitualReport case study deep-dive format with structured sections
SummoningForm contact form with animated submission state
JetBrains Mono for code/label text and Tektur display font for headings
publicApiSurface: Sigil({ id, size, color, className }) — renders an SVG sigil by ID from the sigils data map
GlowFrame({ color, animate, className, children }) — bordered card with neon glow shadow
GlyphButton({ color, variant, fullWidth, type, disabled, onClick, children }) — styled button with glyph aesthetic
PortalNav — sticky top navigation bar with sigil icons and mobile drawer
ParticleField — fullscreen canvas particle animation, respects prefers-reduced-motion
RuneDivider — decorative horizontal rule with a centered sigil
Layout — root wrapper providing ParticleField, PortalNav, AnimatePresence, and footer
TimelineEntry({ year, title, description, isLast }) — animated timeline row
TraitSigilGrid — grid of five personality trait sigil tiles
SummoningCircle — interactive project selector list
ProjectPanel({ project }) — animated project detail panel
RuneTile({ skill }) — single skill tile with mastery badge
TomeCard({ entry }) — writing entry card with date and channel
RitualReport({ study }) — full case study report renderer
SummoningForm — contact form with animated send confirmation
projects[] — array of project objects (id, title, description, tags, image, demoUrl, sourceUrl, bindingNotes)
skills[] — array of skill objects (id, name, category, mastery, description, sigilId)
writing[] — array of writing entry objects (id, title, excerpt, date, channel, url)
caseStudies[] — array of case study objects (id, title, sigilId, sections[])
sigils{} — map of sigil ID → SVG path string
